Hello,

you have been invited to getafjob. Open this link to create your account:

{link}

The link works once and expires on {expires}.
mail.invitation.subject: Your invitation to getafjob
mail.magic_link.body:
Hello {name},

open this link to sign in:

{link}

The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this mail.
mail.magic_link.subject: Your sign-in link for getafjob
mail.recovered.body:
Hello {name},

someone signed in to your account with a mail link instead of a passkey on {time}.

If this was you, add a new passkey on your account page:

{account}

If it was not you, sign in with your passkey, sign out all other sessions and tell the operator.
mail.recovered.subject: Signed in without a passkey
mail.recovery.body:
Hello {name},

someone asked to sign in to getafjob without your passkey.

If this was you: request a sign-in link again after {ready}. It then works until {until}.

If this was not you: sign in with your passkey. That cancels the request at once, and your account stays protected in the meantime.

{login}
